description: This file defines Redux state management for 'cards' in a web application, including actions, selectors, and async thunks for handling card data, sorting, filtering, and related operations.

methods.name: refreshCards
methods.description: Async thunk to refresh card blocks based on a timestamp, fetching relevant blocks from the client.

methods.name: limitCard
methods.description: Helper function to limit card data based on template status and update timestamp.

methods.name: getCard
methods.description: Selector factory to retrieve a specific card or template by ID.

methods.name: titleOrCreatedOrder
methods.description: Function to order cards by title or creation date.

methods.name: manualOrder
methods.description: Function to order cards based on a manual view order.

methods.name: sortCards
methods.description: Function to sort cards based on view sort options, including title, properties, and custom logic.

methods.name: searchFilterCards
methods.description: Function to filter cards based on search text matching titles or properties.
